network: The cert kernel has no network: the spec fetches pinned distributions (sha256-checked) and uv resolves them alone (no-index, find-links in /home/uv.toml via UV_CONFIG_FILE). PyPI over the kernel's CONNECT proxy (TLS with SSL_CERT_FILE) was checked by hand on the Node entry with nodeTransport: uv venv && uv pip install requests && uv run python -c 'import requests' → 2.34.2 /home/u/.venv.
